description: This file defines the NestedArray class providing utility methods for working with nested arrays of variable depth, including get, set, unset, merge, and filter operations.

classes.name: NestedArray
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for manipulating nested arrays of variable depth, including retrieval, setting, unsetting, merging, and filtering.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a nested array given an array of parent keys, with an optional reference parameter to check key existence.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in a nested array at the location specified by an array of parent keys, with optional force parameter to create non-array parents.

methods.name: unsetValue
methods.description: Removes a key from a nested array at the location specified by an array of parent keys.

methods.name: keyExists
methods.description: Checks if a nested array contains the specified sequence of parent keys.

methods.name: mergeDeep
methods.description: Recursively merges multiple arrays, with latter values replacing earlier ones when not both are arrays.

methods.name: mergeDeepArray
methods.description: Recursively merges an array of arrays, with optional preservation of integer keys.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Recursively filters a nested array using a callable function.
